newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Maseca upgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Maseca upgraded to hold.

text.p: Brokerage house Abaco upgraded Mexican corn-flour producer Maseca to a hold from a sell recommendation, it said on Tuesday.

-- "We believe that due to the advantages of using corn flour (21 percent higher tortilla production), the industry could accelerate its growth, but this is likely to occur only by 1998 at the earliest," Abaco wrote in the report.
-- "The company's immediate future seems uncertain; however, there is now hope for a medium-term solution to the subsidy problem," it said.
-- "Taking this into consideration, and given the company's overall positive fundamentals, we are changing our recommendation from sell to hold," it said.
